feeds.title: Sunburst School of Music Blog
feeds.description: What's new at Sunburst? Tune in for the latest on our community of enthusiastic music students and teachers including insightful articles, new initiatives, and more. Since 2011, Sunburst School of Music has been helping aspiring musicians of all ages get started with music and take their playing to the next level.

feeds.title: Bored In Pittsburgh Blog
feeds.description: Writing about music in lieu of human interaction. After living in Pittsburgh for about a years, I spend a lot of time listening to music. Figured I would spend some time writing about it, too. I post weekly about my favorite albums, daily song recommendations, as well as finding and posting some new stuff as it comes out.

feeds.title: Pittsburgh Music Magazine
feeds.description: Find out the Worldwide Music News from The Steel City. Established in 2012 Pittsburgh Music Magazine was founded to bring music news to the masses, not just Pittsburgh, but worldwide. It is an outlet to promote musicians and their art where it is often underrepresented.

feeds.title: Mark Ferrari
feeds.description: Catch up with Mark Ferrari and read about his latest performances in various venues across Pennsylvania. Mark is a is a singer/songwriter from Pittsburgh, PA. He has opened up for a long list of national acts. He has also performed VIP Preshow Parties at the Post Gazette Pavilion for many well known artists.

feeds.title: UniSound Blog
feeds.description: Giving you the latest news and event information on Pittsburgh's Youth Music Performance and Education Organizations. UniSound aims to create a more accessible, sustainable, and equitable youth music ecosystem in the greater Pittsburgh area through building an alliance of organizations which provide music education and performance opportunities for youth.

feeds.title: Pittsburgh City Paper » Music
feeds.description: Learn about Pittsburgh's local music scene with fresh content featuring local musicians, concerts, music reviews, new releases, mp3 streaming and more. Our mission is to serve the greater Pittsburgh region with journalistic integrity, wit, and compassion, while amplifying the voices in the communities we serve, through both our news reporting and our arts and entertainment coverage.

feeds.title: The Pitt News » Music
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the local music scene with University of Pittsburgh's Daily Student Newspaper. The Pitt News has been the University of Pittsburgh's award-winning daily student newspaper since 1910. It strives to promote discourse on campus and inform the Pitt student body about issues affecting college students at the University and across the country.

feeds.title: Kathys Music Blog
feeds.description: Discover how the various courses at KinderMusik helps students improve their music skills through Kathy's music blog. Kathy's Music studios encourage a lifelong love of music by offering classes for everyone, from babies through adults.

feeds.title: Women Who Rock Blog
feeds.description: The blog features articles on Women who Rock in various aspects. Women Who Rock is a crusade to champion women in music and women's health awareness. The site connects through the power of music and helps to educate, support and fund women-centric health and music endeavors.

feeds.title: HughShows Blog
feeds.description: HughShows Blog has featured thousands of original live band photos and has conducted over 1000 musician interviews since starting. The website began in 2004 as an outlet for founder Hugh Twyman's photographic documentation of the Pittsburgh music landscape. Since then it has become the premiere source for local music in the region.
